human_instructions_incorporated.summary: Keep the left third available for mandatory website copy.

creative_thesis.thesis_statement: The reference's monumental authority should survive through scale tension and environmental framing, while its centered composition must yield to the brief's mandatory copy architecture.
creative_thesis.communication_problem: Retain a strong reference anchor that was expressed through centered subject dominance despite a hard left-copy constraint.
creative_thesis.creative_answer: Move the subject to the right, preserve monumental scale contrast, rebuild environmental framing around the displaced subject and turn the left field into intentional negative space.
creative_thesis.desired_viewer_perception: The piece retains the reference's authority and depth while feeling designed for this website message.
creative_thesis.rationale: The Translator's functional goal is preserved even though its recommended placement is modified.

commercial_psychology.rationale: Authority must coexist with immediate message readability.

narrative_tension.central_tension: Monumental subject authority versus open communicative space.
narrative_tension.subject_role: A commanding figure embedded in a larger system.
narrative_tension.environment_role: Frames and amplifies the subject while releasing pressure toward copy.
narrative_tension.relationship: Dense framing gathers around the right subject and opens deliberately to the left.
narrative_tension.rationale: The modified composition converts conflict into directional reading.

subject_strategy.presence: Dominant on the right rather than centered
subject_strategy.relationship_to_environment: Environmental masses frame and scale the subject
subject_strategy.relationship_to_viewer: Direct authority with room for the proposition

emotional_strategy.rationale: The reference's force survives without crowding the copy.

visual_hierarchy.reason: Mandatory message must be read immediately after the subject.
visual_hierarchy.relationship_to_previous: Receives attention through the opening environment.

visual_hierarchy.reason: Carries reference monumentality and connects the fields.
visual_hierarchy.relationship_to_previous: Frames subject and releases toward copy.

creative_concept.visual_world: Monumental environmental masses concentrate around the subject and open into communicative space.
creative_concept.narrative_function: Preserve authority while making room for the new proposition.
creative_concept.composition_logic: Right-weighted asymmetry replaces centered symmetry; scale tension and framing retain reference force.
creative_concept.depth_logic: Framing layers cross the subject plane and recede toward the copy field.
creative_concept.environment_logic: Density is concentrated only where it amplifies subject scale or directs reading.
creative_concept.typography_role: Headline is the deliberate counterpart to the subject, not an overlay squeezed around it.

candidates.concept_summary: Displace the subject but preserve authority through scale and framing.
candidates.decision_reason: It preserves why the anchor worked while changing where it occurs.

candidates.concept_summary: Keep the subject centered exactly as recommended.
candidates.decision_reason: A hard user constraint outranks the Translator's compositional recommendation.

candidates.concept_summary: Shrink the subject to maximize copy space.
candidates.decision_reason: Solves layout by sacrificing the essential reference function.

ideation.convergence_summary: The final direction modifies position, not purpose: monumental authority survives through new mechanisms compatible with the brief.

selected_direction.name: Authority Opens the Field
selected_direction.concept: A right-side monumental subject is framed by dense environmental mass that releases into mandatory left copy space.
selected_direction.why_it_won: It honors the brief while retaining the Translator's intended authority, scale and depth.
selected_direction.creative_risk: Asymmetry may feel like a standard split hero if environmental framing lacks force.
selected_direction.originality_strategy: Translate centered monumentality into asymmetric scale tension rather than discard or copy it.

visual_mechanisms.name: ASYMMETRICAL_MONUMENTAL_FRAMING
visual_mechanisms.function: Preserve monumental subject authority in a right-weighted layout.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Final accepted mechanism resolving the Translator/director disagreement.

visual_mechanisms.name: SCALE_CONTRAST
visual_mechanisms.function: Maintain subject dominance despite displacement from center.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Preserves the functional reason centered composition worked.

visual_mechanisms.name: DENSITY_TO_NEGATIVE_SPACE_RELEASE
visual_mechanisms.function: Move reading from dense subject framing into left copy space.
visual_mechanisms.rationale: Turns the hard constraint into a compositional advantage.

accepted_anchors.director_decision: Accepted and used to retain monumentality after subject displacement.
accepted_anchors.rationale: Scale is compatible with the hard copy constraint.

modified_anchors.translator_recommendation: Preserve centered subject because symmetry creates monumental authority.
modified_anchors.director_decision: Move the subject right and preserve authority through asymmetrical framing plus scale contrast.
modified_anchors.rationale: Centered placement occupies the mandatory left-copy zone; the function survives through a compatible mechanism.

director_overrides.translator_recommendation: Keep subject centered to preserve monumental authority.
director_overrides.director_decision: Use right-side subject dominance with asymmetrical environmental framing.
director_overrides.rationale: The user-explicit left-copy zone is HARD. The override changes placement but retains monumentality, depth and scale tension.

creative_constraints.statement: The left third must remain usable for mandatory copy.
The modified composition must retain reference-level subject monumentality.

banned_tropes.name: GENERIC_SPLIT_HERO
banned_tropes.description: Isolated right portrait and empty left gradient with no spatial relationship.
banned_tropes.reason: Would satisfy layout while destroying the reference's depth and monumentality.

frozen_decisions.decision: Subject dominates on the right; left third remains copy-ready.
Monumentality survives through asymmetrical framing and scale contrast.

strong_guidelines.decision: Environmental density releases directionally toward copy.

open_decisions.decision: Exact framing objects, lens, lighting and typography implementation.

confidence.rationale: The disagreement is resolved with explicit authority, rationale and final mechanisms.

technical_handoff.creative_goal: Preserve reference monumentality while obeying the mandatory left-copy architecture.
technical_handoff.selected_direction_summary: Right-side monumental subject uses asymmetrical framing and scale contrast; density releases into left copy space.
